f.title: Classify any untoward medical occurrence in a trial subject as an adverse event regardless of causality
f.statement: An adverse event is any harmful and unintended sign (including abnormal laboratory findings), symptom or disease occurring in a subject given an investigational product, and need not have a causal relationship with the product.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: "이상반응"(Adverse Event, AE)이란 임상시험용 의약품을 투여한 시험대상자에게 발생한 모든 유해하고 의도하지 않은 증후(症候, sign, 실험실 실험 결과의 이상 등을 포함한다), 증상(症狀, symptom) 또는 질병을 말하며, 해당 임상시험용 의약품과 반드시 인과관계를 가져야 하는 것은 아니다.
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets the scope of safety data collection. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: "Adverse event (AE)" means any harmful and unintended sign (including abnormal laboratory test results), symptom or disease occurring in a trial subject administered an investigational product, and it need not necessarily have a causal relationship with the investigational product.

f.title: Treat responses at any dose where causality cannot be ruled out as adverse drug reactions
f.statement: An adverse drug reaction is any harmful and unintended response to an investigational product at any dose where a causal relationship with the product cannot be denied.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: "약물이상반응"(Adverse Drug Reaction, ADR)이란 임상시험용 의약품의 임의 용량에서 발생한 모든 유해하고 의도하지 않은 반응으로서 임상시험용 의약품과의 인과관계를 부정할 수 없는 경우를 말한다.
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept; it decides which events need sponsor expedited reporting. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: "Adverse drug reaction (ADR)" means any harmful and unintended reaction occurring at any dose of an investigational product where a causal relationship with the investigational product cannot be denied.

f.title: Apply the five seriousness criteria, including medically important events, to AEs and ADRs
f.statement: A serious AE/ADR is one at any dose that results in death or is life-threatening; requires or prolongs hospitalisation; causes persistent or significant disability or incapacity; causes a congenital anomaly or abnormality in a foetus; or is another medically important event such as drug dependence or abuse or blood disorders.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: "중대한 이상반응ᆞ약물이상반응"(Serious AEᆞADR)이란 임상시험용 의약품의 임의 용량에서 발생한 이상반응 또는 이상약물반응 중에서 다음의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. 1) 사망하거나 생명에 대한 위험이 발생한 경우 2) 입원할 필요가 있거나 입원 기간을 연장할 필요가 있는 경우 3) 영구적이거나 중대한 장애 및 기능 저하를 가져온 경우 4) 태아에게 기형 또는 이상이 발생한 경우 5) 1)부터 4)까지의 사례 외에 약물 의존성이나 남용의 발생 또는 혈액질환 등 그 밖에 의학적으로 중요한 상황이 발생하는 사례
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept; seriousness drives the reporting clocks in 8.러. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: "Serious AE/ADR" means an adverse event or adverse drug reaction occurring at any dose of an investigational product that falls under any of the following: 1) death or a threat to life; 2) need for hospitalisation or prolongation of hospitalisation; 3) permanent or significant disability or functional impairment; 4) a malformation or abnormality in a foetus; 5) other than 1) to 4), cases where a medically important situation occurs, such as drug dependence or abuse, or blood disorders.

f.title: Assess expectedness against the Investigator's Brochure or product labelling
f.statement: An unexpected ADR is one whose nature or severity is not consistent with the available product information, such as the Investigator's Brochure or the package insert.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: "예상하지 못한 약물이상반응"(Unexpected ADR)이란 임상시험자 자료집 또는 의약품의 첨부 문서 등 이용가능한 의약품 관련 정보에 비추어 약물이상반응의 양상이나 위해의 정도에서 차이가 나는 것을 말한다.
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept; the reference safety information is the IB or the label. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: "Unexpected adverse drug reaction" means an adverse drug reaction whose nature or severity differs from that indicated by the available product information, such as the Investigator's Brochure or the package insert of the product.

f.title: Ensure subjects receive medical care for all adverse events during and after the trial
f.statement: During and after the trial, the principal investigator shall ensure that subjects receive adequate medical care for all adverse events, including clinically significant laboratory abnormalities, and shall tell subjects about intercurrent illnesses needing care.

rows.quote: 임상시험 중 또는 임상시험 이후에도 시험책임자는 임상시험에서 발생한 모든 이상반응(임상적으로 의미있는 실험실 실험 결과의 이상을 포함한다)에 대해 대상자가 적절한 의학적 처치를 받을 수 있도록 하여야 하고, 시험책임자가 알게 된 대상자의 병발(倂發) 질환이 의학적 처치가 필요한 경우에는 그 사실을 대상자에게 알려야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: investigator duty kept because it shapes the trial safety process the sponsor oversees. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: During or even after the clinical trial, the principal investigator shall ensure that subjects can receive appropriate medical treatment for all adverse events occurring in the trial (including clinically meaningful abnormal laboratory results), and where an intercurrent illness of a subject that the principal investigator becomes aware of requires medical treatment, shall inform the subject of that fact.

f.title: Submit the current Investigator's Brochure and each revision to the IRB
f.statement: The principal investigator seeking IRB approval shall submit the latest Investigator's Brochure and, if it is revised during the trial, the revised version.

rows.quote: 임상시험 계획서에 대한 심사위원회의 승인을 받으려는 시험책임자는 심사위원회에 최신의 임상시험자 자료집 사본을 제출하여야 하며, 해당 임상시험 도중에 임상시험자 자료집이 개정된 경우에는 그 개정된 임상시험자 자료집 사본을 제출하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: kept because the IB is the reference safety information. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: A principal investigator who intends to obtain IRB approval of the protocol shall submit a copy of the latest Investigator's Brochure to the IRB, and where the Investigator's Brochure is revised during the trial, shall submit a copy of the revised Investigator's Brochure.

f.title: Promptly report SUSARs, risk-increasing changes and new safety information to the IRB
f.statement: The principal investigator shall promptly report to the IRB: deviations to remove immediate hazards; changes increasing risk to subjects or significantly affecting the trial; unexpected serious ADRs; and new information that may adversely affect subject safety or trial conduct.

rows.quote: 시험책임자는 제5호나목3)자)(1)부터 (4)까지의 사항에 대하여 심사위원회에 신속히 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: the four matters are listed in 5.나.3)자) (quoted in the translation file); (3) is unexpected serious ADRs. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The principal investigator shall promptly report to the IRB the matters in item 5.나.3)자)(1) to (4).

f.title: Record premature unblinding due to an SAE and promptly tell the sponsor
f.statement: In a blinded trial, if the blind is broken before completion, accidentally or because of a serious adverse event, the principal investigator shall record this and promptly inform the sponsor.

rows.quote: 눈가림 임상시험에서 우발적으로 또는 중대한 이상반응으로 임상시험 완료 이전에 눈가림이 해제된 경우 시험책임자는 이 사실을 기록하고 신속히 의뢰자에게 알려야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where, in a blinded clinical trial, the blind is broken before completion of the trial accidentally or because of a serious adverse event, the principal investigator shall record this fact and promptly notify the sponsor.

f.title: Report changes that increase subject risk to the sponsor and IRB in writing
f.statement: The principal investigator shall promptly report in writing to the sponsor and the IRB any change that increases risk to subjects or significantly affects the conduct of the trial.

rows.quote: 시험책임자는 대상자에 대한 위험이 증가하거나 임상시험의 실시 여부에 중대한 영향을 미치는 변화 또는 변경이 발생하였을 때에는 이를 의뢰자 및 심사위원회에 신속히 문서로 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where a change or alteration occurs that increases the risk to subjects or significantly affects whether the trial is conducted, the principal investigator shall promptly report it in writing to the sponsor and the IRB.

f.title: Report all SAEs promptly in writing to the sponsor, using subject ID codes
f.statement: The principal investigator shall promptly report all serious adverse events (except those the protocol or IB exempt from immediate reporting) to the sponsor in writing within the protocol-defined period and method, using the subject identification code instead of personal identifiers, and following any sponsor AE reporting guidance.

rows.deadline: Promptly, within the period set in the protocol
rows.quote: 시험책임자는 모든 중대한 이상반응(임상시험 계획서나 임상시험자 자료집 등 그 밖의 문서에서 즉시 보고하지 않아도 된다고 정한 것은 제외한다)을 임상시험 계획서에 정한 기간 내에 그 계획서에서 정한 보고방법에 따라 서면으로 신속히 의뢰자에게 보고하여야 한다. 이 경우 시험책임자는 대상자의 신상에 관한 비밀을 보호하기 위하여 대상자의 성명, 주민등록번호 및 주소 등 대상자의 신상정보를 대신하여 시험대상자식별코드를 사용하여야 하며, 의뢰자가 제공하는 이상반응의 보고에 관한 지침이 있는 경우에는 이에 따라야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: kept as the inbound SAE flow to the sponsor; no numeric clock in the source, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The principal investigator shall promptly report all serious adverse events (excluding those that the protocol, the Investigator's Brochure or other documents specify need not be reported immediately) to the sponsor in writing, within the period set in the protocol and according to the reporting method set in it. In this case, to protect the confidentiality of the subject's identity, the principal investigator shall use the subject identification code instead of personal information such as the subject's name, resident registration number and address, and shall follow the sponsor's guidance on adverse event reporting, if any.

f.title: Report protocol-specified AEs of special interest and lab abnormalities to the sponsor
f.statement: The principal investigator shall report to the sponsor the adverse events or laboratory abnormalities that the protocol identifies as critical to safety evaluation, within the period and by the method set in the protocol.

rows.deadline: Within the period set in the protocol
rows.quote: 시험책임자는 임상시험 계획서에서 안전성 평가와 관련하여 중요하다고 별도로 정한 이상반응이나 실험실 검사결과의 이상 등을 임상시험 계획서에서 정한 기간 내에 그 계획서에서 정한 보고방법에 따라 의뢰자에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The principal investigator shall report to the sponsor the adverse events or abnormal laboratory test results that the protocol separately designates as important for safety evaluation, within the period set in the protocol and according to the reporting method set in it.

f.title: Supply autopsy reports and terminal medical records for reported deaths
f.statement: When reporting a death, the principal investigator shall submit additional information such as the autopsy report (if an autopsy was done) and terminal medical reports to the sponsor and the IRB.

rows.quote: 사망 사례를 보고하는 경우 시험책임자는 의뢰자와 심사위원회에 부검 소견서(부검을 실시한 경우만 해당한다)와 최종 의무기록(terminal medical reports) 등의 추가적인 정보를 제출하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: When reporting a death, the principal investigator shall submit to the sponsor and the IRB additional information such as the autopsy report (only where an autopsy was performed) and the terminal medical reports.

f.title: Inform subjects and ensure follow-up when a trial is terminated or suspended
f.statement: Where a trial is terminated early or suspended, the principal investigator shall inform subjects immediately and ensure appropriate measures and follow-up.

rows.quote: 1)부터 3)까지의 규정에 따라 해당 임상시험이 조기종료 또는 중지된 경우 시험책임자는 대상자에게 이 사실을 즉시 알리고 적절한 조치와 추적조사가 이루어질 수 있도록 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where the trial is terminated early or suspended under 1) to 3), the principal investigator shall immediately inform the subjects and ensure that appropriate measures and follow-up are carried out.

f.title: A sponsor may set up a data monitoring committee, which must have SOPs and keep minutes
f.statement: The sponsor may establish a data monitoring committee to periodically assess trial progress, including safety data and critical efficacy endpoints, and to advise on continuing, modifying or stopping the trial. The committee shall have SOPs and shall prepare and keep minutes.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 안전성 관련 자료와 중요한 유효성 결과변수를 포함한 임상시험의 진행 정도를 주기적으로 평가하고 해당 임상시험의 진행, 변경 또는 중지 여부에 대한 자문을 할 자료모니터링위원회를 설치할 수 있으며, 자료모니터링위원회는 업무 수행에 필요한 표준작업지침서를 마련하고, 회의록을 작성ᆞ보관하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: setting up a DMC is permitted (할 수 있으며); SOPs and minutes are mandatory once one exists, noted in the statement. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor may establish a data monitoring committee that periodically assesses the progress of the trial, including safety-related data and critical efficacy endpoints, and advises on whether to continue, modify or stop the trial; the data monitoring committee shall prepare the SOPs needed to perform its work and shall prepare and keep minutes.

f.title: Report discontinued clinical development to investigators, sites and MFDS
f.statement: Where clinical development of the investigational product is discontinued, the sponsor shall report this to investigators, trial sites and MFDS.

rows.quote: 임상시험용 의약품의 임상개발이 중단된 경우 의뢰자는 시험자, 임상시험실시기관 및 식품의약품안전처장에게 그 사실을 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where clinical development of the investigational product is discontinued, the sponsor shall report that fact to the investigators, the trial sites and the Minister of Food and Drug Safety.

f.title: Validate electronic trial data systems and control audit trail, access, backup and blinding
f.statement: A sponsor processing trial data electronically or using remote systems shall: confirm and document that systems meet its requirements for completeness, accuracy, reliability and consistency; set system use in SOPs; design data changes to be recorded without deleting entered data; secure against unauthorised access; keep a list of persons authorised to change data; keep backups; maintain blinding during data entry and processing; and follow MFDS rules on electronic records and signatures.

rows.quote: 임상시험자료를 전자적으로 처리하거나 원거리전산시스템을 이용하려는 의뢰자는 다음 사항을 준수하여야 한다. 가) 임상시험자료를 전자적으로 처리하기 위한 시스템 및 원거리전산시스템의 완전성, 정확성, 신뢰성 및 일관성이 의뢰자가 설정한 요구사항에 맞는지 확인하고, 해당 확인사항을 기록하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: one row for 바.1); quote is the lead-in and 가); 나)-아) (SOPs, audit trail without deletion, security, authorised list, backup, blinding, e-records) are in the statement and translation file. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: A sponsor who intends to process clinical trial data electronically or use remote computer systems shall comply with the following: a) confirm that the completeness, accuracy, reliability and consistency of the systems for electronic processing of trial data and of the remote computer systems meet the requirements set by the sponsor, and record the confirmation.

f.title: Design data correction so changes are logged and original entries are never deleted
f.statement: Systems for electronic trial data shall record the correction process and not delete previously entered data, and the sponsor shall verify this.

rows.quote: 임상시험자료를 전자적으로 처리하기 위한 시스템 및 원거리전산시스템의 자료 수정 방식은 자료의 수정과정을 기록하고 기존에 입력한 자료는 삭제하지 않도록 설계되어야 하며, 의뢰자는 이를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: split out from the systems row because audit trail is a distinct testable requirement. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The data correction method of systems for electronic processing of trial data and of remote computer systems shall be designed to record the correction process and not to delete previously entered data, and the sponsor shall verify this.

f.title: Retain essential documents and extend retention when MFDS directs or the sponsor needs
f.statement: The sponsor shall keep essential documents and other data under section 9 and relevant laws, and shall extend the retention period where MFDS directs or the sponsor judges it necessary.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 제9호 및 관계 법령에 따라 기본문서와 그 밖의 자료를 보관하여야 한다. 다만, 식품의약품안전처장이 지시하거나 의뢰자가 필요하다고 판단한 경우에는 보관기간을 연장하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: the retention period itself is set elsewhere (relevant laws); none stated here. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor shall retain essential documents and other data in accordance with section 9 and relevant laws. However, where the Minister of Food and Drug Safety directs it or the sponsor judges it necessary, the retention period shall be extended.

f.title: Write an Investigator's Brochure with expected risks and adverse reactions
f.statement: Based on non-clinical and prior clinical data, the sponsor shall prepare an Investigator's Brochure with information on expected risks or adverse reactions, special tests and observations and other precautions, and give it to investigators.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 1)에 따라 확보한 정보를 기초로 임상시험에서 예상되는 위험 또는 이상반응에 대한 정보, 특수검사 및 관찰에 필요한 정보와 그 밖의 주의사항을 담은 임상시험자 자료집을 작성하여 시험자에게 주어야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: kept as the reference safety information. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Based on the information obtained under 1), the sponsor shall prepare an Investigator's Brochure containing information on risks or adverse reactions expected in the trial, information needed for special tests and observations, and other precautions, and give it to the investigators.

f.title: Update the Investigator's Brochure when significant new safety information arises
f.statement: Where the sponsor obtains important new information on safety or efficacy, it shall revise the Investigator's Brochure accordingly.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 안전성과 유효성에 관한 중요한 정보를 새로 얻은 경우에는 이에 맞춰 임상시험자 자료집을 수정하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where the sponsor newly obtains important information on safety and efficacy, it shall revise the Investigator's Brochure accordingly.

f.title: Allow rapid identification of the product and detectable unblinding in emergencies
f.statement: Even when coding investigational products for a blinded trial, the sponsor shall ensure the product can be quickly identified in an emergency and that any unblinding is detectable.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 눈가림시험을 실시하기 위하여 임상시험용 의약품을 코드화하는 경우에도 응급상황에서 임상시험용 의약품의 종류를 쉽게 알아볼 수 있고 눈가림해제 사실이 드러날 수 있도록 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Even where the sponsor codes the investigational product to conduct a blinded trial, it shall ensure that the identity of the investigational product can easily be recognised in an emergency and that the fact of unblinding can be revealed.

f.title: Continuously evaluate the safety of the investigational product
f.statement: The sponsor shall continuously evaluate the safety of the investigational product.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 임상시험용 의약품의 안전성에 대한 평가를 지속적으로 실시하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor shall continuously evaluate the safety of the investigational product.

f.title: Promptly report safety findings that affect subjects, trial conduct or IRB approval
f.statement: Where the sponsor obtains safety information that could endanger subjects, affect whether the trial continues, or change the IRB decision, it shall report it promptly to investigators and MFDS.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 대상자의 안전을 위협하거나, 임상시험의 실시 여부에 영향을 미치거나, 임상시험의 진행과 관련하여 심사위원회의 결정사항을 변경하게 할 만한 임상시험용 의약품의 안전성에 관한 정보를 취득한 경우에는 시험자 및 식품의약품안전처장에게 신속히 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where the sponsor obtains information on the safety of the investigational product that could threaten the safety of subjects, affect whether the trial is conducted, or change the IRB's decision on the progress of the trial, it shall promptly report it to the investigators and the Minister of Food and Drug Safety.

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 days
f.statement: The sponsor shall report every fatal or life-threatening serious unexpected ADR to investigators, MFDS and, where needed, the IRB within 7 days from the date it was reported to or became known by the sponsor.

rows.deadline: Within 7 days from the date the sponsor was told or became aware
rows.quote: 의뢰자는 중대하고 예상하지 못한 모든 약물이상반응을 시험자, 식품의약품안전처장 및 필요한 경우 심사위원회에 다음의 구분에 따른 기한까지 보고하여야 한다. 가) 사망을 초래하거나 생명을 위협하는 경우: 의뢰자가 해당 사실을 보고받거나 알게 된 날부터 7일 이내.
rows.review_note: Review: days read as calendar days (일). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor shall report all serious and unexpected adverse drug reactions to the investigators, the Minister of Food and Drug Safety and, where necessary, the IRB by the following deadlines: a) where it results in death or is life-threatening: within 7 days from the date the sponsor received a report of or became aware of the fact.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs in clinical trials

f.title: Complete fatal or life-threatening SUSAR reports within 15 days of first awareness
f.statement: If not all Form 77 information (ADR term, final outcome, ADR summary, etc.) was reported in the 7-day report, the sponsor shall submit a follow-up report with detailed information within 15 days from first awareness.

rows.quote: 다만, 의뢰자는 약물이상반응명, 최종 관찰 결과, 약물이상반응 요약서 등 별지 제77호서식 약물이상반응 보고서에 따른 정보가 모두 보고되지 않은 경우 최초로 해당 약물이상반응에 대한 사실을 보고받거나 알게된 날부터 15일 이내에 해당 약물이상반응에 대한 상세한 정보를 포함하여 추가로 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: However, where not all information under the Form 77 adverse drug reaction report, such as the ADR name, final observed outcome and ADR summary, has been reported, the sponsor shall make an additional report including detailed information on the adverse drug reaction within 15 days from the date it first received a report of or became aware of the adverse drug reaction.

deadline_rule.clock_start: 최초로 해당 약물이상반응에 대한 사실을 보고받거나 알게된 날부터
deadline_rule.applies_to: Follow-up of fatal or life-threatening SUSARs whose initial report was incomplete

f.title: Report other SUSARs within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor shall report other serious unexpected ADRs to investigators, MFDS and, where needed, the IRB within 15 days from the date it was reported to or became known by the sponsor.

rows.deadline: Within 15 days from the date the sponsor was told or became aware
rows.quote: 나) 그 밖의 중대하고 예상하지 못한 약물이상반응의 경우: 의뢰자가 해당 사실을 보고받거나 알게 된 날부터 15일 이내
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: b) for other serious and unexpected adverse drug reactions: within 15 days from the date the sponsor received a report of or became aware of the fact.

deadline_rule.applies_to: SUSARs that are not fatal or life-threatening

f.title: Keep reporting follow-up information on SUSARs until the case is closed
f.statement: Where there is additional information on a reported ADR, the sponsor shall keep reporting until the ADR is closed, meaning it resolves or follow-up becomes impossible.

rows.quote: 의뢰자는 1)에 따라 보고한 약물이상반응의 추가적인 정보가 있는 경우에는 해당 약물이상반응이 종결(해당 약물이상반응이 사라지거나 추적조사가 불가능하게 되는 것을 말한다)될 때까지 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no clock stated for follow-ups. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where there is additional information on an adverse drug reaction reported under 1), the sponsor shall report it until the adverse drug reaction is closed (meaning the adverse drug reaction disappears or follow-up becomes impossible).

f.title: Use Form 77 with a CIOMS-I summary for SUSAR reports to MFDS
f.statement: When reporting ADRs to MFDS, the sponsor shall use the Form 77 ADR report with an ADR summary such as a CIOMS-I form attached.

rows.quote: 의뢰자가 식품의약품안전처장에게 1)에 따라 약물이상반응을 보고하려는 경우에는 별지 제77호서식의 약물이상반응 보고서에 CIOMS-Ⅰ서식 등 약물이상반응 요약서를 첨부하여 제출하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where the sponsor intends to report an adverse drug reaction to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety under 1), it shall submit the adverse drug reaction report in Form 77 with an ADR summary such as the CIOMS-I form attached.

f.title: Have monitors check that all adverse events were reported as required
f.statement: Monitors shall check whether all adverse events have been reported according to this standard, the protocol, IRB reporting criteria and relevant laws.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: 모든 이상반응을 이 기준, 임상시험 계획서, 심사위원회에서 정한 보고기준 및 관계 법령에서 정한 바에 따라 보고하였는지 여부
rows.review_note: Review: item in the list of monitor checks; framed as a monitor duty. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Whether all adverse events have been reported in accordance with this standard, the protocol, the reporting criteria set by the IRB and relevant laws.

f.title: Report early termination or suspension promptly in writing with reasons
f.statement: Where a trial is terminated early or suspended, the sponsor shall promptly report the fact and reasons in writing to the principal investigator and MFDS, and in multicentre trials notify the principal investigators at other sites in writing.

rows.quote: 임상시험이 조기종료되거나 중지된 경우 의뢰자는 시험책임자 및 식품의약품안전처장에게 해당 사실과 사유를 신속히 문서로 보고 하여야 하며, 다기관임상시험의 경우에는 다른 임상시험실시기관의 시험책임자에게도 해당 사실과 사유를 문서로 통지하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where a trial is terminated early or suspended, the sponsor shall promptly report the fact and the reasons in writing to the principal investigator and the Minister of Food and Drug Safety, and in a multicentre trial shall also notify the principal investigators of the other trial sites of the fact and reasons in writing.
